premise: Woodpecker knocks on every door to invite everyone to a party; sleepy Owl answers, blinks, and goes straight back to sleep.
inspiration: The knock-knock rhythm of folk games and the gathering pattern of The Enormous Turnip, turned: the one who can't come is still remembered.
lesson: Good friends remember the ones who can't join in.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Knocks on Doors
en-US.text: Woodpecker {woodpecker:hop} {woodpecker:face happy} had a wonderful idea: a party in the clearing! And he knew just how to invite everyone. {woodpecker:live} He tapped on the tree, {sfx:knock} knock, knock, knock, listened, shook off the dust, and chirped. Who's there? Badger {badger:pulse} poked his nose out. {badger:face happy} [excited] A party? I'll bring blackberries! Knock, knock, on the next tree up. Who's there? [slowly] Nobody answered. Knock, knock, KNOCK! {owl:live} Owl opened one eye. He blinked. He looked around. He fluffed up his feathers, gave a great big yawn… and fell straight back to sleep. {owl:face sleeping} [giggles] Oh dear, whispered Woodpecker. {woodpecker:face surprised} Owl sleeps in the daytime! {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:hop} [softly] So they {canvas:confetti 0.4 6s} had the party very, very quietly, and saved Owl the biggest blackberry {owl:hearts} for tonight.

es-ES.title: Toc, toc: ¡hay fiesta!
es-ES.text: El pájaro carpintero {woodpecker:hop} {woodpecker:face happy} tuvo una idea estupenda: ¡una fiesta en el claro! Y sabía muy bien cómo invitar a todos. {woodpecker:live} Dio unos golpecitos en el árbol, {sfx:knock} toc, toc, toc, escuchó, se sacudió el polvo, y pió. ¿Quién es? Tejón {badger:pulse} asomó el hocico. {badger:face happy} [excited] ¿Una fiesta? ¡Yo llevo moras! Toc, toc, en el árbol de al lado. ¿Quién es? [slowly] Nadie contestó. Toc, toc, ¡TOC! {owl:live} Búho abrió un ojo. Parpadeó. Miró a su alrededor. Se ahuecó las plumas, dio un bostezo enorme… y se volvió a dormir. {owl:face sleeping} [giggles] Vaya, susurró el carpintero. {woodpecker:face surprised} ¡Búho duerme de día! {woodpecker:face happy} {woodpecker:hop} [softly] Así que {canvas:confetti 0.4 6s} hicieron la fiesta muy, muy bajito, y le guardaron a Búho la mora más grande {owl:hearts} para esa noche.

knock.prompt: a woodpecker knocking three quick light taps on a hollow tree door
